subject: The 5pm treat that ruined my progress
preview_text: I was killing it for weeks. Then I made this one mistake. Here's the fix.
body_paragraphs: I was two weeks into the plan. My dog, Max, had already dropped 3 pounds. I was feeling like a champ. Then one evening, I gave him a 'tiny' piece of my dinner chicken. Just a bite. Next weigh-in? Zero progress. That's the #1 mistake that kills results: random treats you don't account for.

Most owners think a small bite here and there won't matter. But those extra calories add up fast. It's not just the treats—it's the guilt of seeing those sad eyes. But here's the truth: if you don't track every single calorie, you're sabotaging their health. And the fix is simpler than you think.

That's why we built the calorie calculator into PupShape. You can log any treat—even that chicken bite—and it adjusts the meal plan automatically. No guesswork, no guilt. Just honest tracking that keeps you in control. Plus, it shows you exactly how many treats you can give without stalling progress.

Open the app right now. Log that treat you almost forgot from breakfast. Then check your updated plan for today. P.S. Most users who skip this step are the same ones who see zero results in week 3. Don't be them.
